title: Himachal Pradesh becomes the 18th Indian state and East Punjab is reduced to its current form as Doaba.
text: Himachal Pradesh is a state in the northern part of India. Situated in the Western Himalayas, it is one of the 13 mountain states and is characterised by an extreme landscape featuring several peaks and extensive river systems.

title: 1971 Indian Airlines hijacking by Kashmiri militants.
text: On 30 January 1971, an Indian Airlines Fokker F27, named Ganga, flying from Srinagar to Jammu, was hijacked by two Kashmiri separatists belonging to the National Liberation Front. The aircraft was flown to Lahore Airport in Pakistan, where the passengers and the crew were released, and was burnt down three days later.

title: The chairman of All India Forward Bloc, Hemanta Kumar Basu got murdered by political opponents in West Bengal.
text: West Bengal is a state in the eastern part of India. It is situated along the Bay of Bengal.

title: The former East Pakistan and eastern Bengal are flooded; thousands flee the area.
text: Bengal is a geographical, ethnolinguistic, historically geopolitical region in South Asia north of the Bay of Bengal. It is politically divided between the sovereign state of Bangladesh, the Indian state of West Bengal, and Karimganj district in the Indian state of Assam.

title: The Odisha cyclone in the Bay of Bengal, in Orissa State in India, kills 10,000.
text: The 1971 Odisha cyclone was a devastating tropical cyclone that struck the Indian state of Odisha on 29 October 1971. The cyclone also affected the Indian state of West Bengal as well as East Pakistan (present-day Bangladesh), which had been devastated by the 1970 Bhola cyclone just less than a year prior and was in the middle of Bangladesh Liberation War.

title: Two day state visit by Indira Gandhi to United States.
text: Indira Priyadarshini Gandhi was an Indian stateswoman who twice served as the Prime Minister of India from 1966 to 1977 and again from 1980 until her assassination in 1984. She was India's first and only female prime minister, and a central figure in Indian politics as the leader of the Indian National Congress (INC).

title: 17 December: India and Pakistan fight their second major war, over East Pakistan, which ends after 93,000 Pakistani troops surrender. The new nation of Bangladesh is created out of East Pakistan.
text: The India–Pakistan war of 1971, also known as the third Indo-Pakistani war, was a military confrontation between India and Pakistan that occurred during the Bangladesh Liberation War in East Pakistan from 3 December 1971 until the Pakistani capitulation in Dhaka on 16 December 1971. The war began with Pakistan's Operation Chengiz Khan, consisting of preemptive aerial strikes on eight Indian air stations.

title: The Indian navy destroyer INS Rajput sinks Pakistani submarine PNS Ghazi (former USS Diablo).
text: A submarine is a watercraft capable of independent operation underwater. (It differs from a submersible, which has more limited underwater capability.) The term "submarine" is also sometimes used historically or informally to refer to remotely operated vehicles and robots, or to medium-sized or smaller vessels (such as the midget submarine and the wet sub).

text: The Bangladesh Liberation War, also known as the Bangladesh War of Independence, was an armed conflict sparked by the rise of the Bengali nationalist and self-determination movement in East Pakistan, which resulted in the independence of Bangladesh with the help of India. title: Leslie Claudius (field hockey player) is awarded the Padma Shri.
text: Hockey, or field hockey in North America, is a fast-paced team sport in which two teams of eleven players use curved sticks to manoeuvre a small, hard hockey ball towards the rival team's shooting circle and then into the goal. The team with the most goals at the end of play wins the match.

title: India defeat England in the third and the final Test at the Oval. This happens to be India's first victory ever on the English soil.
text: Test cricket is a format of the sport of cricket, considered the game's most prestigious and traditional form. Often referred to as the "ultimate test" of a cricketer's skill, endurance and temperament, it is a first-class format of international cricket where two teams in whites, each representing their country, compete over a match that can last up to five days.
